description: This file contains the implementation of the Recent Dashboard controller class in the OpenCart admin extension. It handles displaying recent orders and dashboard configuration settings.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller class for managing and displaying the recent activities dashboard in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the recent dashboard page, gathers orders and configuration data, and loads the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving dashboard configuration settings via POST data, returning JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a string of HTML content representing recent order data for dashboard display.
